doctor.source: canonical validators plus AR-8 candidate authorities

ceremony: precheck: inspect active and retained key-version metadata only
issue_or_import: prepare replacement key material outside evidence
bind_replacement: bind active plus retained previous in the governed Worker secret authority
switch_active: make replacement active while reads retain previous
verify: reconcile old ciphertext and require old encrypted-record dependency count zero
retire_previous: retire only after replacement verification and zero dependency proof
concern_plans.recovery: Interrupted reconciliation keeps the previous key retained; retry bounded reconciliation and reject stale-key writes.

ceremony: precheck: inspect active and bounded retained lookup-HMAC versions
issue_or_import: prepare replacement lookup-HMAC version outside evidence
bind_replacement: bind active plus bounded retained versions
switch_active: new identities use only the replacement version
verify: require zero live record, idempotency and refresh-lease dependencies before retirement
retire_previous: retire only a non-active version with zero dependency counts
concern_plans.recovery: Ambiguous, missing or stale version metadata fails closed; keep retained versions until dependency counts reach zero.

ceremony: precheck: inspect accepted key ids and temporary legacy-v1 compatibility metadata
issue_or_import: prepare replacement caller-auth key outside evidence
bind_replacement: resolver accepts replacement plus previous before signer switch
switch_active: control-plane signer emits v2 with exactly the replacement key id
verify: bounded staging traffic verifies the named replacement key id
retire_previous: retire previous or legacy-v1 only after no accepted caller depends on it
concern_plans.recovery: Keep the previous accepted key during failed cutover; unknown or revoked key ids, replay and stale requests fail closed.

ceremony: precheck: inspect explicit active encryption and lookup versions
issue_or_import: prepare replacement encryption and lookup versions outside evidence
bind_replacement: retain previous versions before switching explicit active fields
switch_active: write only replacement versions while old versions remain readable
verify: reconcile and require zero encrypted-row and lookup-row dependencies on retired versions
retire_previous: retire only after dependency proof and replacement verification
concern_plans.recovery: A failed switch retains previous versions; interrupted reconciliation is retryable and CAS concurrency failures remain fail closed.

ceremony: precheck: verify intended Cloudflare account, bucket and Worker binding names metadata-only
issue_or_import: issue a separate replacement R2 token only in an explicitly governed staging ceremony
bind_replacement: bind Access Key ID and Secret Access Key atomically outside evidence
switch_active: replacement pair becomes the intended Worker binding only in that governed ceremony
verify: bounded staging R2 capability verification and binding metadata check must succeed
retire_previous: revoke previous provider token only after replacement verification
concern_plans.recovery: Keep the previous provider token valid until replacement verification; routine application promotion never rotates this pair.

ceremony: precheck: match staging OAuth client id and authorized redirect URI metadata
issue_or_import: add replacement client secret while previous remains enabled when an explicitly governed staging provider ceremony is performed
bind_replacement: write-only bind replacement to staging GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
switch_active: staging resolver uses replacement binding without changing AR-8A user-token authority
verify: bounded staging authorization-code and refresh-token exchanges must succeed before disable
retire_previous: disable previous first and delete only after a bounded rollback observation window
concern_plans.recovery: Before deletion, keep or re-enable the previous Google secret and restore its Worker binding if verification fails; deletion is final for that secret.

ceremony: precheck: match staging application client id and registered Web redirect URI metadata
issue_or_import: add replacement passwordCredential before removing previous when an explicitly governed staging provider ceremony is performed
bind_replacement: capture secretText only at issuance and write-only bind MICROSOFT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
switch_active: staging resolver uses replacement binding without changing AR-8A user-token authority
verify: bounded staging authorization-code and refresh-token exchanges plus keyId/endDateTime metadata verification must succeed
retire_previous: remove previous passwordCredential by keyId only after replacement verification
concern_plans.recovery: Keep the previous passwordCredential valid and restore its Worker binding if verification fails; removed credentials are not treated as recoverable.

profile_security_plans.operator_rule: Never display root/KEK/DEK material; expose only allowed key-version identifiers, wrapped-reference/dependency state and readiness. The one-device Secret Vault smoke is prototype evidence, not production key authority.
profile_security_plans.recovery_rule: Do not retire a root/KEK version until reconciliation and restore evidence required by the later owning gates exists.

profile_security_plans.operator_rule: Expose fingerprint policy/generation identity and secret-handle presence/provider status only; never entropy bytes or the raw secret-handle value.
profile_security_plans.recovery_rule: No in-place entropy rewrite; identity change requires a new profile generation and certification.

profile_security_plans.operator_rule: Expose device identity, provider/key-version status and key-presence state only; never private-key bytes or the raw device key handle.
profile_security_plans.recovery_rule: Loss/revocation is handled through the owning device identity/enrollment authority; do not export private key material for recovery.

profile_security_plans.operator_rule: Expose provider/route/version/status and non-reversible reference metadata only; never proxy username/password/token material or the raw secret handle.
profile_security_plans.recovery_rule: Real network/proxy cutover must fail closed when the scoped credential authority is missing, rejected or cross-environment.

profile_security_plans.operator_rule: Expose expiry/redemption/device-binding outcome only; the single-use claim value remains redacted and never appears with profile ID/JWT/R2 credentials/keys in the custom URI.
profile_security_plans.recovery_rule: Expired/replayed/rebound claims are not reused; issue a fresh claim through the owning enrollment authority.

profile_security_plans.operator_rule: Expose non-secret issuance reference, scope, expiry and generation-binding state only; never bearer credential/capability material and never reuse the static control-plane R2 pair on Profile Bridge.
profile_security_plans.recovery_rule: Expired/revoked scoped access is reissued only after current tenant/profile/generation/device/lease authorization is proven.

profile_noncredential_state_policy.rule: Launch-intent authorization state and fencing/lock coordination remain fail-closed state authorities, not secret/provider credential registries.
